$comment: WAC Lighting (architectural and landscape lighting, WAC Lighting Co.) runs a WordPress site with product pages under /product/<name>/ (for example Axel Wall Light 3000K, with SKUs WS-W44011-BK and WS-W44014-BK). The product name is the h1 (class bt) and the description is the meta description. WAC sells through showrooms and distributors and the SKU and dimension tables are rendered in a form the selectors cannot read, so fetch.engine is default (APP_DEFAULT_ENGINE, ai-crawler-avalai on this instance): the LLM returns 12 specs (SKU and dimension rows) with the image, each checked against the page, at about 2,288+1,647 tokens per request. There is no price on the page (the state the AI reads is call_for_price), so price is not configured and the product returns a PRICE_MISSING warning; price_unit usd only keeps currency USD. Engines tried on the sample on 2026-11-19: http: SUCCESS with title and description; browser: the same; ai-crawler-avalai: the same plus the image, 12 specs and call_for_price. ai-crawler-avalai is selected because it returns the SKU and dimension specs. Needs APP_AI_CRAWLER_ENABLED with an AvalAI key on the instance. Checked against the saved (curl) Axel Wall Light 3000K page on 2026-11-19.
